description: This Java source file implements the class InterestScheduleModelRepositoryWrapperImpl, which provides methods for managing ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel objects associated with loans. It handles storage, retrieval, and processing of interest schedule models, interacts with repositories, and performs transactional operations related to interest scheduling in a loan portfolio management system.

classes.name: InterestScheduleModelRepositoryWrapperImpl
classes.description: Implementation of InterestScheduleModelRepositoryWrapper that manages interest schedule models related to loans, providing creation, retrieval, and processing functionalities.

methods.name: writeInterestScheduleModel
methods.description: Stores a ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel linked to a loan, converting it to JSON and saving it within a transaction with specific flush mode.

methods.name: findOneByLoanId
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgressiveLoanModel associated with a given loan ID within a transactional flush context.

methods.name: findOneByLoan
methods.description: Retrieves a ProgressiveLoanModel associated with a given Loan object within a transactional flush context.

methods.name: extractModel
methods.description: Converts a ProgressiveLoanModel into a ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel by parsing stored JSON data.

methods.name: hasValidModelForDate
methods.description: Checks if a ProgressiveLoanModel exists for a loan ID and is valid for a specific date.

methods.name: getSavedModel
methods.description: Retrieves and processes a saved interest schedule model for a loan and business date, including recalculating interest if applicable.

methods.name: readProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel
methods.description: Reads and reconstructs a ProgressiveLoanInterestScheduleModel for a given loan ID using the stored JSON, detail, and installment multiplier.
